shoulder_assembly.file: 02_人体骨骼晶格肌肉方案/输出/shoulder_design/s1_y2_transition_stock/assembly_check.json

scope: Selected prescribed GH poses and load steps. Compare the moving cap, its hardware and both eye packages against original S1-Y2 rigid hardware. Opposite free cap and swivels stay at their neutral positions, but bone-owned parts follow GH. TPU, wire solids and bench fixtures are excluded. Adjacent supports can legitimately have near-zero gaps. Tip turns represent point bends in the lower-bound model; there is no designed support at those tips.
